assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Matches the declared z exactly and is located on the South_view door dimension chain

claims.reason: South_view.png ground-floor door column vertical dimension chain reads, from the 2F floor/slab line downward: 600 (gap above the door's transom), 900 (transom panel height), 1500 (door-leaf height down to the ground floor). World z origin is the 1F floor at z=0; the chain's own datum is the 2F slab at absolute z=3.0 (matching the 1F floor-to-floor height). Merging the transom+leaf segments (900+1500=2400mm) into one span below the 600mm gap: lengths=[600,2400], origin_m=3.0, direction=-1, segment index 1 gives absolute span [0,2.4], i.e. the full door opening from ground floor to head, matching the declared z=[0,2.4].

decision.reason: Matches the declared z exactly and is located on the East_view ground-floor window dimension chain, cross-checked against South_view

claims.reason: East_view.png ground-floor vertical dimension chain (left of the window column) reads, from the upper floor slab downward: 200 (slab/lintel gap), 1800 (window height), 1000 (sill to ground-floor level). World z origin is the 1F floor at z=0 (dimension chain's own datum is the 2F slab at absolute z=3.0, matching 1F's 3.0m floor-to-floor). Using origin_m=3.0 and direction=-1, segment index 1 (the 1800mm window-height segment) yields the window's absolute sill/head span. Identical sill(1.0m)/head(2.8m) proportions are independently confirmed by the matching 200/1800/1000 bottom chain visible on South_view.png.

decision.reason: Matches the declared z exactly and is located on the East_view upper-floor window dimension chain, cross-checked against South_view and North_view

claims.reason: East_view.png upper-floor vertical dimension chain (top of the window column) reads, from the roof/parapet line downward: 800 (parapet gap), 1800 (window height), 1000 (sill to 2F floor level). World z origin is the 2F floor at absolute z=3.0. Reordering bottom-up as [1000,1800,800] with origin_m=3.0 and direction=1, segment index 1 (the 1800mm window-height segment) yields absolute sill=4.0m, head=5.8m, matching the declared opening z=[4.0,5.8]. The same 800/1800/1000 proportions are independently confirmed on South_view.png and North_view.png upper-floor chains.
